task.system: Extract the work order into exactly one JSON object with these keys and no others: id (string), date (as YYYY-MM-DD), total_cents (integer cents, equal to the sum of qty*unit_cents over items), paid (boolean), status (string), items (an array where each element has EXACTLY the keys name (string), qty (integer), unit_cents (integer cents) and no other keys - do not add a per-item total). Output only the JSON object: no prose, no markdown fences. Example: {"id":"WO-1","date":"2025-01-01","total_cents":300,"paid":true,"status":"done","items":[{"name":"Filter","qty":2,"unit_cents":150}]}
task.output_contract: exactly one JSON object with keys id (string), date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), total_cents (integer cents = sum of qty*unit_cents), paid (boolean), status (string), items (array of {name, qty, unit_cents}); no prose

decision_rule: 'regression' only if the exact-json paired-difference 95% CI excludes 0 AND |diff| exceeds the upper bound of the A-vs-A-repeat paired-difference CI; else 'no detectable regression at n=40' reported with the minimal detectable effect at 80% power. A cost-per-item increase beyond max_cost_increase_pct fails `ci` regardless of pass rate.
headline_template: On a {n}-item deterministic extraction golden set (run {date}), {modelA} passed {kA}/{n} ({pA}%, 95% Wilson CI {loA}-{hiA}%) and {modelB} passed {kB}/{n} ({pB}%, CI {loB}-{hiB}%); paired difference {diff} pp (95% CI {dlo} to {dhi}) against a same-model repeat disagreement of {noiseK}/{n}; cost per item ${cA} vs ${cB}.

amendment.reason: The v1 system prompt named only the top-level keys, not the item sub-schema (name/qty/unit_cents), so no model could produce an exact match (pilot condition A: 0/40, all valid JSON with description/quantity/unit_price_cents). The prompt now states the full schema the output_contract already documented. Prompt-only amendment made after a pilot and BEFORE any published measurement; pilot run withdrawn; golden unchanged. OTR D-012 precedent.
